title: The Quartz Yak of Kite Shadow Day
description: The yak stands still while kite flyers trace the colors its quartz horns cast on the limestone. By evening, wind will scatter the ochre.
alt: A shaggy yak with translucent quartz horns stands above three people tracing colorful kite shapes on a pale mountain ledge.
pairing: An imagined late-summer kite holiday × a yak whose quartz horns cast kite-shaped shadows
